title: A Protocol for the Archive
author: Wren Okafor
blurb: Mara Okonkwo, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
